evidence: Model results on the corrected design climate (the run named in settings, years 10-19) at T21: mixed slabs of water under each cell's sunlight, sky, air and 10 m wind, with the lake model's bulk exchange paired at the run's lowest level as the waters' oxygen study pairs it. The still cases trade no water and take that level's wind over water, raised by the forcing's one factor for the wind inside a 3-day mean, with no shelter, no sea breeze and no gust of the boundary layer's eddies; the shore cases' exchange is a stated share, taken with the open water's body. A calm deep water's own surface late in the lunar day lies above its body: at the five sites of checks the lake model's 20 m column puts it between the still 4 m and 2 m layers. The climate model and CM1 differ on the air near the ground, a gap the project carries as a range.
reading_rule: Temperatures in C of a mixed layer of the stated depth, over hourly steps of ten years, rounded to a hundredth before the classes and shares are counted. The run's water cells are the seas and the large lakes; there sea_surface is the run's own surface, a mixed layer 50 m deep: the body of the upper water. On land cells the waters stand at the cell's mean ground level and mixed_10m is the body of a lake's upper water. Read the body as the surface only where the surface is kept mixed into it; a calm surface follows the still layers. hours_above_X are hours of each lunar day (708.7 h). Classes are bins of 2 K from under 28 C to 40 C and more. by_latitude gives area-weighted means over the cells of each band of |latitude|; wind_level_mean_m_s is the lowest level's wind the waters take, floored and raised; wind_mean_m_s is that wind at 10 m over water; run_wind10_vector_mean_m_s is the run's own 10 m wind, the speed of its mean vectors over each cell's own ground.

settings.pairing: the lowest level, as PlaSim pairs it

grid.note: The run's own frame, the turned Moon's; the near side is centred on longitude 0.
